name: Rubber Ducky
tagline: Rubber duck debugging, except the duck already knows what you did.
description: A rubber duck on your desktop, lit by your CI: green while everything passes, yellow while a pull request wants you, and red with horns when a pipeline breaks. He quacks in a speech balloon rather than out loud, because open-plan offices are a thing. A reference consumer of the Greenlight SDK, in which the whole integration is about twenty lines.
